text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report requests that Scarborough Community Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 107 Oakridge Drive. The application indicates the reason for removal is due to concerns related to the potential for tree failure. The subject tree is a red oak tree (Quercus rubra), measuring 58 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Denied the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 107 Oakridge Drive.
